# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, please report it privately.

- Contact: <himanshuto4to@outlook.com>
- Subject: `Security: <short description>`

Please include:

- A clear description of the issue and impact
- Reproduction steps (or a proof-of-concept)
- Affected URLs and browser/device details (if relevant)

## Supported Versions

This is a personal static site. Only the current `main` branch is considered supported.

## Disclosure

Please do not open public issues for security reports until the issue is fixed or acknowledged.
